description: Closing-line value: each outcome's opening and closing fair price before the start, the move between them and the result once graded, for one market, a player, a league or a date. Kept for every market recorded two-sided before its start. Costs 5 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/clv. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: markets starting that day (US Eastern).

limit.description: Rows per page, default 50. Free returns at most 100.

since.description: ISO 8601 time. Free reads only the last 7 days.

until.description: ISO 8601 time: markets starting at or before it.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_clv
